text: The Walrasian auctioneer disappears in the AI2AI economy because autonomous agents orchestrated by large language models and running on globally distributed compute negotiate directly and simultaneously across all markets at machine speed.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The AI-to-AI Economy and the Collapse of Anthropocentric Economic Theory (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5886442
